name: Taurine

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A conditionally essential sulfonic amino acid, abundant in heart and skeletal muscle, involved in bile salt conjugation, osmoregulation and calcium handling.

systems.note: Taken for cardiac and metabolic effect; the intended effect.
Also taken for skeletal-muscle and osmoregulatory effect.

monitors.why: The metabolic endpoint most consistently reported.
